metadata.title: Chrono-Map | Stories of Place
metadata.description: Use one map to understand the story behind every place. Explore historical landmarks, film locations, and cultural heritage through time.

hero.subheadline: Use one map to understand the story behind every place. Explore historical landmarks, film locations, and cultural heritage across cities and across time.

features.headline: Explore History Like Never Before
features.description: Our platform combines cutting-edge technology with rich historical content to create an immersive time-traveling experience.

interactiveHeritageMap.title: Interactive Heritage Map
interactiveHeritageMap.description: Explore layered history through our interactive map. Each pin reveals the story behind a place.

thenNowComparison.title: Then & Now Comparison
thenNowComparison.description: Slide through time to see how locations have transformed over decades. Historical photos meet modern reality.

filmLocationTours.title: Film Location Tours
filmLocationTours.description: Discover where iconic movies like The Matrix were filmed. Walk in the footsteps of cinema history.

qrCodePlaques.title: QR Code Plaques
qrCodePlaques.description: Scan physical plaques at locations to instantly access rich historical content and AR experiences.

mobileFirstExperience.title: Mobile-First Experience
mobileFirstExperience.description: Designed for explorers on the go. Access stories, photos, and navigation right from your pocket.

curatedWalkingTours.title: Curated Walking Tours
curatedWalkingTours.description: Follow expertly crafted routes that connect multiple historical points into meaningful journeys.

footer.brandTagline: Use one map to understand the story behind every place.

cta.headline1: Every Street Corner Has a Story.
cta.headline2: Are You Ready to Discover Them?
cta.description: From historic landmarks to film locations and cultural heritage, every place holds layers worth discovering. Follow stories through the map and see how places change across time.

aiPlanner.title: AI Travel Planner
aiPlanner.subtitle: Your personal place guide
aiPlanner.mockUser1: I have 2 days in a new city and love history plus film locations.
aiPlanner.mockAi1: I can build a route around landmark stories, filming locations, and memorable local stops. Tell me the city and how much time you have.
aiPlanner.mockUser2: Add some food spots along the way!
aiPlanner.pageSubtitle: Tell me about your trip and I'll create a personalized place-based itinerary
aiPlanner.comingSoonDescription: We're training our AI on layered local history, hidden gems, and place-based experiences. Soon you'll be able to chat with our AI to plan a smarter route through any city.
